  self.feet=d.site_xpos[[1,2]].copy();self.feet[:,2]=self.p.get('footz',0.005)
  self.feetR=d.site_xmat[[1,2]].reshape(2,3,3).copy()
  # Make feet horizontal while preserving initial heading.
  for k in range(2):
   yaw=np.arctan2(self.feetR[k,1,0],self.feetR[k,0,0]);c=np.cos(yaw);ss=np.sin(yaw)
   self.feetR[k]=np.array([[c,-ss,0],[ss,c,0],[0,0,1]])

  rows=[];targets=[]
